apps.name: ACTION GAME MAKER G
apps.short_description: Create full-fledged 2D games without any programming, now with the all-new "Maker Mode" that brings the ease of use the series is known for! Combining the accessibility of the Maker series with the extensibility of Godot Engine!

apps.name: Anne Frank House VR
apps.short_description: Experience Anne Frank’s hiding place as it was in 1942-1944. Wander through the rooms, where Anne Frank and 7 others hid during WW2. Immerse yourself in her world, her thoughts, and her feelings.

apps.name: Basecoat
apps.short_description: Turn your STL files into painted, VTT-ready miniatures. Automatic shadows & highlights, bucket fill, free paint, custom stamps and more. Export for Tabletop Simulator, TaleSpire or as OBJ.

apps.name: ClickAssist
apps.short_description: A local Windows click automation utility with profiles, sequences, position picking, dry-run testing, and a compact Mini Controller.

apps.name: ClipCabinet
apps.short_description: Organize Steam, OBS Studio, and NVIDIA GeForce / ShadowPlay recordings in one library. Add folders, tag and search clips, watch them in the built-in player, and export MP4.

apps.name: CMPNN
apps.short_description: CMPNN turns your secondary display into a premium PC companion dashboard. Track weather, system stats, gaming sessions, media, devices, timers and more through a modern, touch-focused interface.

apps.name: Comicalizer
apps.short_description: Write your plot in a simple form or as plain text, and Comicalizer lays out a full chapter of manga storyboards: panels, camera angles, poses, expressions, speech balloons and effect lines. Direct each shot with real film and manga terms, fine-tune any panel, and export layered PSD files.

apps.name: ControllerMeta
apps.short_description: ControllerMeta is a professional-grade Windows controller diagnostic and analysis tool designed specifically for hardcore gamers and controller enthusiasts.

apps.name: CopperCube 6 Game Engine
apps.short_description: CopperCube is a full-featured 3D game engine. No programming needed! Create 3D games and apps quickly. Includes terrain editor, low poly modelling tools, 3D models, precreated game AI, effects and more.

apps.name: Crosshair Ultimate
apps.short_description: Make every shot feel better! Crosshair Ultimate lets you build custom animated and reactive crosshairs in seconds. Pick from thousands of ready designs, switch with hotkeys, and upgrade your shooting experience with zero FPS impact and 100% anti-cheat safety.

apps.name: DashPanel
apps.short_description: Create fully customizable dashboard displays for your favourite racing sims on your PC (USB monitors, USB480, VoCore, overlay mode on screen or SteamVR compatible HMD).

apps.name: DeckCrate
apps.short_description: A fast, privacy-focused file manager built for your Steam Deck and handheld. Drive it entirely with a controller — D-pad to move, A to open, B to go back — or use mouse and keyboard. Copy, move, batch-rename, compress, preview, and mount images. Zero telemetry, ever.

apps.name: ePaperCraft SHIRYU
apps.short_description: [English Manual Now Available] Draw in 3D, unfold your design into printable parts, and print. With SHIRYU alone, your 3D design becomes a real papercraft model. Includes 70+ models, a Windows interface in 9 languages, and the free SHIRYU Model Photo Studio for owners.

apps.name: FantasySynth - GrooveBox
apps.short_description: FantasySynth is a Groovebox Synth that's Fully Controllable by Midi, QWERTY keys, or Gamepad. Easy to use and customize with a 5 Track Pattern based Arranger and Looper for composing entire Masterpieces.

apps.name: Galaxy Audio Visualizer
apps.short_description: Experience your music like never before in a spectacular galaxy. Constant audio calibration makes every song a distinct visual journey, while deep customization lets you make it truly yours. Enjoy it in a window, fullscreen, or as a desktop wallpaper.

apps.name: Golden Goblin Player
apps.short_description: Turn your local files into a media platform of your own. Videos, music, audio works, books, images and games in one place — rediscovered through automatic tags, search and recommendations. Play funscripts on their own or in sync with media. Optional hardware support; a complete player without it.

apps.name: Heai: Virtual Companion
apps.short_description: Customize your 3D virtual companion to your liking and let him keep you company every day. Early Access includes character appearance customization, Steam Workshop (mods for AI-powered interaction with him; creating and sharing custom clothing), Pomodoro sessions with him, and lo-fi music.

apps.name: HyperION DAW
apps.short_description: HyperION DAW is a modern Windows music production workstation with MIDI editing, VST3 plug-ins, procedural generators, mixing, mastering and a fast creative workflow.

apps.name: Keycast
apps.short_description: Show keyboard, mouse and XInput controller input on your Windows desktop. Choose from 86 skins, eight preset layouts and four key effects. Combine layouts, add animal keycaps, and show or hide the overlay with a shortcut.

apps.name: Live2DViewerEX
apps.short_description: The best cross-platform Live2D solution, three display modes (Wallpaper / Desktop / Desktop Window), multiple platforms (Windows / MacOS / Android / iOS), high-precision facial capture, and many other features.

apps.name: Macro Mesh
apps.short_description: Macro Mesh sits under every game you play. Macros in a node-based programming language, bound to anything. A crosshair you drew. The clip, after it happens. Game servers for your group, a password vault, screen savers. One app instead of five, built by a gamer and steered by gamers.

apps.name: MPE Insight
apps.short_description: A real-time MIDI and MPE visualizer, MIDI monitor and MPE synth for any MIDI keyboard. See every note with its pressure, pitch bend and timbre as visuals, keys and live sheet music. Draw MPE notes, record MIDI, export video and audio. DRIFT adds MPE movement to an ordinary keyboard.

apps.name: MPE Keys
apps.short_description: A real-time MIDI keyboard and piano visualizer with a built-in MPE synth and live sheet music. Every note is drawn on the key itself: pressure as color, velocity as brightness, bend as a moving dot, timbre as rings. Scale Lock and chords on keys. No controller? Your computer keyboard plays it.

apps.name: Next Eye
apps.short_description: Control your PC directly from VR with intuitive gestures and simple interactions. Designed for people who spend hours in VR and don't want to remove their headset just to use their PC. Stay immersed, stay comfortable, and enjoy a smarter way to use your setup.

apps.name: Nvil
apps.short_description: Nvil is a polygon modeling application. Its deep customization ability provides ways for user to create fast and comfortable workflow to suit individual needs.

apps.name: Oeee Cafe
apps.short_description: An online drawing community inspired by the oekaki boards of the 2000s. Draw with classic oekaki painters and replay every drawing stroke by stroke, create or join communities around the topics you love, and draw solo or together with friends on a shared canvas.

apps.name: OpenSheet 3.5e SRD
apps.short_description: Create, manage, and level D&D 3.5e SRD characters with powerful rules-aware automation. Build complex characters in minutes, automatically calculate statistics, manage spells and equipment, and keep every modifier accurate in a fast offline desktop application.

apps.name: OpenSpeedy
apps.short_description: OpenSpeedy is a free and open-source speed controller for Windows single-player games. you can speed up or slow down any game in real time, no kernel driver required. Switch speeds instantly with customizable hotkeys, five gear presets, and a hold-to-speed mode, putting every game in your control.

apps.name: OVR Space Dragger
apps.short_description: Free and easy to set up, OVR Space Dragger is a dedicated playspace mover for SteamVR games like VRChat. Press a button and drag your world. It’s a great first step into space drag, and an alternative for anyone who finds complicated setups annoying.

apps.name: PortalVR Motion
apps.short_description: Motion controls for VRChat and hundreds of Steam titles. Use webcam-tracked Joy-Cons, PSMove, your smartphone, or VR controllers you already own. Head, hand, and face tracking bring your whole self to VRChat on Desktop. VR mods unlock motion controls for R.E.P.O., Halo 3, and more.

apps.name: RPG in a Box
apps.short_description: Bring your stories and ideas to life! RPG in a Box lets you create games and other interactive experiences in a fun and simple way. It's a flexible, accessible tool designed for everyone: whether it's your first game or you're an experienced creator, there's something in it for you!

apps.name: ScreenPlay
apps.short_description: ScreenPlay is an Open Source cross-platform app for displaying Wallpaper, Widgets and AppDrawer.

apps.name: ShaderGlass
apps.short_description: Tool for applying shader effects on top of Windows desktop for gaming, pixel art and video.

apps.name: Slime Locomotion
apps.short_description: Inertial sensor-based natural locomotion solution. By capturing human posture, it enables movement in four directions—forward, backward, left, and right—and supports mapping motion signals to SteamVR, keyboard, and controllers, while also supporting hip orientation tracking.

apps.name: SlimeStorm
apps.short_description: SlimeStorm is a professional danmaku (bullet hell) design tool that lets you create various types of bullet patterns without writing any code. It is especially well-suited for Touhou Project-style danmaku.

apps.name: Spiroshader
apps.short_description: Real-time visuals that dance to your music. Classic MilkDrop presets, and stunning GPU shaders in one playlist. True HDR, a psychedelic webcam mirror with green screen, logo overlays, and OBS-ready output for content creators.

apps.name: Standable: Full Body Estimation
apps.short_description: Standable Full Body Estimation is a method of estimating points of your body that are not currently tracked by 3-point tracking solutions.

apps.name: Sticker Shop Cozy Idle
apps.short_description: Catch drifting sticker packs, open them for cute and rare finds, then choose what to collect or sell in this cozy incremental shop game. Upgrade your tools, complete your album, hire assistants, and grow a tiny stand into a bustling three-counter shop.

apps.name: Turbo Play
apps.short_description: A full-scale Video, Image, Audio and Animation editor and sequencer with AI features, 300+ video effects and transitions in multiple languages.

apps.name: Voice Notes
apps.short_description: Talk instead of type. Dictate into any app, say commands like "open Steam", or turn rambling speech into a polished message, prompt, translation, or voice clip. The AI runs on your PC: no account, no API key.

apps.name: VoiceHealer
apps.short_description: Cleaner mic audio in one click, with less noise, less headset playback fed directly into your mic, and steady volume. For games, streams, and chat.

apps.name: VR Fast & Simple
apps.short_description: Choose videos in the Windows app. Press play on Meta Quest 3. Enjoy flat-screen, 3D, VR180 and 360° playback, with sound in your headset or PC headphones. Requires initial pairing and the same local network. Some files need preparation.

apps.name: Watertime
apps.short_description: A simple reminder to help you drink more water during the day.

apps.name: Weelco VR
apps.short_description: Weelco VR - Watch, upload and share 360° videos on your Virtual Reality headset.

apps.name: Aquila: All Roads Lead To Rome Playtest

The Colour Beyond: A Zeroth Kind Playtest
We Will Die For You Playtest
