apps.short_description: Fantastic Tames Season 1 brings three new companions: Burrowbuck, Cerberax, and Enigmasaur. Tunnel through the earth, tear through the front lines with multi-headed attacks, or mimic stolen creature-forms!

apps.name: Borderlands®4 - Loveless the Hacker
apps.short_description: Play as the all-new Vault Hunter, Loveless the Hacker, and wield her unique Action Skills and skill trees across all of Kairos. This symbiotic assassin shares her mind with a virus that takes the physical form of a vicious pet Wyrm.

apps.name: Broken & Loved - Adult Content
apps.short_description: Unlock all the sexual content for Broken & Loved with this DLC!, enjoy of interactive and reactive erotic scenes, with sexual development and dialogues that change base on player agency.

apps.name: Capcom Arcade Stadium：STREET FIGHTER II' - Hyper Fighting -
apps.short_description:
Add STREET FIGHTER II' - Hyper Fighting - to your Capcom Arcade Stadium game line-up!

Twelve fighters battle it out to see who will be the world's greatest, but the fight is heating up against the four bosses of Shadaloo. Featuring new fighters and the new Turbo feature, this time the fight's even more exciting!

apps.name: CarX Drift Racing Online - Russian Drift Style
apps.short_description: A city of classic architecture: 300 year old buildings, raising bridges and picturesque parks, it’s all Saint-Petersburg. Its streets have been fenced out for the race so you should get ready to spin your steering wheel to pass a few roundabouts...

apps.short_description:
Casino-themed skins and content will be added to your game!
- Lucy Casino Skin
New Lucy Starting Skill 'Showdown'

New Lucy Base Skill 'Snap!'

apps.name: Crusader Kings III Creator Pack: Arctic Attire
apps.short_description: Brave the chill of far northern lands in style with the Arctic Attire Creator Pack, made in collaboration with the established Crusader Kings III modder Aj.

apps.name: Crusader Kings III Creator Pack: Celestial Court Attire
apps.short_description: This cosmetic addition to Crusader Kings III includes new fashions for the cultures of medieval China and many of its neighbors, including Silla Korea, the Jurchen of the northeast and Central Asian nations.

apps.name: Crusader Kings III Creator Pack: East Asian Wonders
apps.short_description: Decorate your map with 22 of the glorious structures and locations of East Asia in this cosmetic addition to Crusader Kings III, including natural wonders, holy sites and monuments to royal power.

apps.name: Crusader Kings III Creator Pack: High Medieval Warfare Attire
apps.short_description: Gird yourself for battle in fancy new gear with the High Medieval Warfare Attire Creator Pack. Developed by renowned modder JedNick, it includes a range of helmets, headgear and armor from the High Medieval Period (roughly 13th and 14th centuries).

apps.short_description: Add greater variety and more historical detail to your map with Holy Buildings: a new Creator Pack from Crusader Kings III modder Kefir úr with imagery for over a dozen religious buildings. From churches to monuments, Holy Buildings brings more regional and religious flavor to your game experience.

apps.name: Crusader Kings III Creator Pack: Medieval Monuments
apps.short_description: Discover the great architectural achievements of the Middle Ages with the Creator Pack Medieval Monuments. Created in collaboration with the established Crusader Kings III modder PiGu, Medieval Monuments brings 20 new varied and culturally significant monuments to the game.

apps.name: Crusader Kings III: Songs of the Realm
apps.short_description: Crusader Kings III: Songs of the Realm has 13 tracks to accompany your rule, from peaceful courtly melodies to rousing battle themes. Remastered Crusader Kings classics play alongside new arrangements of European folk dances, this Music Pack is the perfect soundtrack for your dynastic ambition.

apps.name: Darkest Dungeon®: The Musketeer

apps.short_description: A creature-collecting extraction RPG where every expedition is a risk. Charm wild Amiko and fight alongside them across an untamed world shaped by your actions. Push deeper or pull out, but only what you extract is yours to keep.

apps.name: Anathema Requiem
apps.short_description: Anathema Requiem is an atmospheric third-person psychological horror game where you must uncover the mystery of an abandoned cemetery where people vanish without a trace.

apps.name: Andrew Labreck's Eden Within
apps.short_description: Eden Within has fast paced, reaction based combat with a unique fighting style in a hedge maze that the player must navigate through. The embodiment of Greed has taken over the area, and he will not leave easily. Explore to find enhancements, learn to use your portals in unique ways and face Greed.

apps.name: Animal Bookshop: Tidy & Sell
apps.short_description: An animal themed book organizing game with customers, shop customization, and a whole lot of tidying!

apps.name: Animal Legends
apps.short_description: In this Action RPG, catch up to 45 unique pets that fight at your side! Raid dungeons, defeat bosses, build your base and defend it from enemy attacks, and face off in online 3 player Capture the Flag PvP!

apps.name: Animals Hate You
apps.short_description: This game is a 1-4 player troll game. You have to control the character to escape with friends while every animal in sight tries to snipe you. Top-down chaos, cruel traps, and places that really do not want you to leave.

apps.name: Anime Mosaic Puzzle
apps.short_description: Relax and restore 230 anime-style illustrations in this casual puzzle game. Drag square pieces into place on boards from 3x3 to 8x8, connect matching neighbors, improve your best times, and unlock Steam achievements—without time limits or fail states.

apps.name: Annie's DineInn
apps.short_description: A cooking game with cozy themed days and horror themed nights. You and your daughter are now owners of an abandoned motel and diner. Start cooking, renting rooms, and do other work to pay off the loan. But beware of the choices you make as they might come back to haunt you. (Solo developer project)

apps.name: Anomaly Core: Hospital
apps.short_description: You are a patient. You should avoid treatment at the old hospital. The crazy doctor's strange methods raise doubts. The treatment may not go as you imagine.

apps.name: Ants TD
apps.short_description: Thousands of ants race for your nest. Dig the paths they follow, block shortcuts with barricades and lure the swarm with fruit, then shoot, burn and blow it all up in a chaotic tower defense.

apps.name: Apex Armada
apps.short_description: A spaceship auto battler where you build a fleet and take on real players. Choose from 16 alien captains to lead your fleet into battle. Spend your gold on ships, guns, shields and other parts. Then watch the battles play out as you climb the ranks to become a Galactic Conqueror.

apps.name: Aphasia
apps.short_description:
Have you ever wondered what happens when we fall into a coma? Why do only some make it back?
Aphasia is a first-person horror where you’re trapped inside your own mind, with no memory of who you are.
As you explore your fractured memories, your sense of guilt won’t let you escape...

apps.name: Apparatus Inspector
apps.short_description: Apparatus Inspector is a retro OS horror simulation where you are locked underground evaluating synthetic AI robots for anomalies. Chat with infected bots, execute commands, deliver judgement, and hide from physical threats to survive your 5-day shift.

apps.name: AquaDucked!
apps.short_description: A physics puzzle game about firing a rubber duck out of a cannon and getting it home in one piece. Place hoses, trampolines and fans, aim, fire, see what happens. 270 levels across 10 worlds, golf, a climbing mode, a level editor, and a pond full of levels other people made.

apps.name: Arcany
apps.short_description: Arcany is a cozy persistent online world set in the mysterious Realm of Gravenmoor. Train skills, explore a magical land, craft powerful items, and uncover the story behind the forgotten cataclysme.

apps.name: Ardhan
apps.short_description: Ardhan is a roguelike deckbuilder where every fight happens on a real board: minions trade, taunts hold the line, weapons break, and the deck you walk out with is never the deck you walked in with. 12 factions, 421 cards, 6 acts, Ascension 1–15 and a Daily Game shared by everyone.

apps.name: Arena of Realms
apps.short_description: Arena of Realms blends auto-battling, team building, and tournament management. Recruit fighters, train your roster, and combine equipment and relics to win a 16-team double-elimination tournament. Scout rivals, place wagers, and compete solo or in multiplayer.

apps.name: Art Shop: Tidy Up!
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person organizing game set in an art shop of rare and beautiful things. Sort 2,942 fine art supplies and artisan pieces in dozens of distinct forms, shelf by shelf, color by color, and unlock skills as the shop becomes a gallery of perfect order.

apps.name: Artificial Ambition
apps.short_description: Build an AI company from a 2017 startup into an industry leader. Hire specialists, train models, launch products, and expand your headquarters. Balance compute costs, customer demand, and investor control in a real-time management strategy game.

apps.name: As Long As She Forgot
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. Play as Marlene, an 86-year-old woman preparing for her family's visit. They're coming. They always do.

apps.name: Ashley AI
apps.short_description: No te pide tu atención, se la queda. Una compañera de escritorio con IA para Windows que habla contigo, te recuerda y controla tu PC de verdad ❤️.

apps.name: Ashram Online
apps.short_description: The world broke a thousand years ago and no one is coming to fix it. Ashram is a classic MMORPG with a survivalist soul: hunt, dismantle and craft every piece you wear. Gather your guild, choose your path... and claim your eternity.

apps.name: Atana
apps.short_description: Atana is a female-led romance visual novel set in late 20th-century America, where you grow alongside your creator, Atana, as an AI.

apps.name: Athena and the Erotic Trap Dungeon Beyond the Forest
apps.short_description: Amorous anomalies, treacherous temptations, and a dungeon overflowing with desire threaten your and the town’s chastity! Explore, dodge, and quests your way to uncovering its secrets, or raise your Lewdness Level and surrender to sensual ruin in this Erotic Trap Dungeon RPG!

apps.name: ATOM RPG 2
apps.short_description: A New Open-World Era of ATOM Begins! 1,225 km² of the Caspian Wastes! Open-world survival game with a story-rich CRPG soul, co-op or alone, vehicles, sandbox, crafting, and strange encounters.

apps.name: Atomic Delivery
apps.short_description: The General Staff has one objective for you: build an atomic weapon aboard a nuclear bomber. Pilot through hostile skies, refine uranium, run industrial machines, assemble the bomb, keep the aircraft airborne and survive everything standing between you and the Atomic Delivery.

apps.name: AutoArena
apps.short_description: AutoArena is a lineup-building auto-chess game. As a fortune-teller, use foresight to acquire divination cards and build your lineup. Engage in multiple rounds of battles against the traces of other fortune-tellers in the Stream of Memories, ultimately guiding yourself toward the right destiny!

apps.name: Avlo the Imp Wizard
apps.short_description: Do the sickest tricks while reaching the finish line the fastest you can!

apps.name: AXE DESCENT
apps.short_description: Over 600 skills, countless strategies. Build your own unique setup from ever-changing possibilities and venture to the deepest reaches of the Rift in this roguelite turn-based command RPG.

apps.name: Babylonian Twins
apps.short_description: The lost puzzle-platformer of ancient Babylon — made in Baghdad in 1993, back as the Definitive Edition in 2026. Freeze one twin to stone while the other dashes, drills and battles through five worlds. Includes the original 1993 Amiga game, fully playable — only on Steam.

apps.name: Backrooms
apps.short_description: Escape the backrooms levels as reality warps with every step; listen, for the whispers behind the walls may guide you out. Enjoy an unbelievable co-op Backrooms experience.

apps.name: Backrooms : The Threshold
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op investigation horror game where you enter the Backrooms through an experimental gateway. Explore procedurally generated environments, document anomalies, recover valuable artifacts, and survive the unknown.

apps.name: Backrooms Anomaly Project
apps.short_description: An anomaly-spotting horror game set in the Backrooms. Explore eerie corridors, study every detail, and spot anything that shouldn't be there. Move forward when everything is normal, or turn back when something is wrong. Avoid the darkness and run when something starts chasing you.

apps.name: Bananageddon
apps.short_description: Bananageddon is a roguelite in which you will have to create and adapt your equipment to defeat the hordes of animals, who will try to prevent you from getting out with the bananas harvested for your tribute!

apps.name: Bandits are Coming
apps.short_description: A low-pressure tower defense where losing costs nothing but time. Place Cowboys, Dynamite, Flamers, Snipers, and Cannons across 10 levels and 20 waves each — gold and towers always carry through a retry, so you're guaranteed to win eventually. Just build, watch, and rebuild.

apps.name: Baskets and Blooms
apps.short_description: Grow what you sell and sell what you grow in this cozy, pressure-free third-person farmer's market simulator. Choose your agricultural identity, nurture your farm at your own pace, play road-trip minigames, and serve customers face-to-face as your small business blooms!

apps.name: Battle Gaze
apps.short_description: Battle Gaze is a fast-paced 2D retro action-adventure hack-and-slash. Master 5 unique weapons—sword, bow, deadly claws, light sword, and hay fork—unleash fluid combos, and defeat ruthless bosses across dangerous lands to reclaim your ancestral heritage!

apps.name: BBBB: Block Block Boom Boom
apps.short_description: BBBB: Block Block Boom Boom is a chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek game where hiders become part of the environment while seekers blast suspicious blocks! But watch closely, hider blocks have slightly more beveled edges than ordinary blocks. Can you spot the difference?

apps.name: Beautiful Subordinates Kneeling Beside Hero
apps.short_description: The night shrouds a villa on the outskirts of New York. Jasper Gray returns, and beautiful subordinates such as Yasmin kneel to greet him. In daily life, they report intelligence and execute instructions, while a rift crisis is quietly approaching.

apps.name: BECOME LIFE
apps.short_description:
A single-player narrative survival experience set in the abandoned landscapes of Gargano, Italy. 
Explore, endure, and uncover what happened after the disappearance where every choice leaves a mark.

apps.name: Bee Shrimp Aquarium
apps.short_description: A 3D aquarium game for watching bee shrimp. Zoom in to see them graze, groom and swim, or feed them and watch them gather. Choose from 12+ aquascapes, change the lighting, and customize the shrimp's patterns, colors and sizes.

apps.name: Before it Falls
apps.short_description: Enter the long-closed St. Elora Hospital for a final technical inspection before demolition. Restore power, explore the building, and examine the records left behind. Before it Falls is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

apps.name: Bento Story
apps.short_description: Bento Story is a bento-arranging simulator with a warm story about a girl deciding her future while serving customers and sending them off with a lunch box that says more than words.

apps.name: Beyond Grief
apps.short_description: An action roguelike set in ancient Egypt where you battle the gods, grow absurdly powerful through build-breaking synergies, kill, die and be reborn. Earning allies, making enemies, and befriending cats along the way.

apps.name: BeyondTheBorder
apps.short_description: You have wandered into the city of Aberrants, “Helikar.” To return to the human city of “Engine,” escape the city where Aberrants roam. A horror escape game.

apps.name: BIER RUSH!
apps.short_description: Carry towers of beer mugs through a packed Oktoberfest hall! Pour, stack, balance and serve: more mugs mean bigger scores and bigger spills. Chase a solo high score or play online with up to 4 players in competitive DUELL and chaotic TEAM SCHICHT co-op.

apps.name: Big Top
apps.short_description: Big Top is an active carnival incremental where every shot, throw, and swing earns tickets. Collect game-changing prizes, build powerful combinations, and conquer the carnival on your quest to claim the legendary Super Playbox!

apps.name: Bio-Shooter
apps.short_description: Medicine vs Germs, inside the human body. Play as glowing living-gel cells and microbes with guns grown from your own body in a fast, class-based online shooter. Battle across the Eye, the Lungs and the Follicles, where blinking eyelids, breathing lungs and sweat floods reshape every fight.

apps.name: Blade Dodger
apps.short_description: A 2D arcade style arena survival game. As Spiff, you will sprint, dodge, and use your special abilities to stay alive long enough to make it through different levels and challenges. Features single player, 2-4 player local co-op, and 2-4 player online multiplayer.

apps.name: Blamcon's Cyber Range
apps.short_description: A day at the range for your Light Gun. Six real range target games on an outdoor range in the woods: paper, a speed plate rack, hanging steel, pop-up targets, a dueling tree, and a Texas star. This can be played with a mouse but it is a light gun game first, best played with Blamcon light guns.

apps.name: Blockfall
apps.short_description: BLOCKFALL is a first-person shooter in a blocky, fully destructible world made to enjoy with friends. Each round, gain an upgrade of your choice from a randomly selected array to boost your odds of victory. no two matches will be the same!

apps.name: Blue Ridge Hunting
apps.short_description: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game set in the Appalachian Mountains. Solo or with friends, investigate, document, and hunt cryptids based on real sightings, legends, and paranormal phenomena from the region.

apps.name: Board Kingdom
apps.short_description: 24 board games in one kingdom. Play Chess, Go, Xiangqi, Shogi, Reversi, Mancala and more against computer opponents. Learn new rules, pick your challenger and build a record in every game.

apps.name: Bong N Brawl
apps.short_description: Dive into a chaotic bullet hell where every second of survival feels amazing! Packed with game-changing upgrades, wildly creative boss fights, and pure arcade fun. Dodge by a hair's breadth, unleash broken builds, and just let loose!

apps.name: Bonobros
apps.short_description: A free strategy game where both sides play at the same time. Plan three actions in secret, then watch everything resolve at once: moves, spells, duels. Take on other players in 1v1, or play solo with lessons and puzzles, including ones made by the community.

apps.name: Bot Colony _redux
apps.short_description:
Use your mic or type: SAY ANYTHING—the robots understand!
In this sci-fi adventure, talk to characters in your own words and command them to manipulate the world as you hunt a spy.
Explore a tropical island where machines have real personalities and emotions. 
Total conversational freedom.

apps.name: Brain Cell
apps.short_description:
Brain Cell is a co-operative multiplayer adventure game. Play up to 4 players co-op to explore dungeons, complete puzzles, with twisting gravity physics.

Explore huge worlds with friends. Work together to complete mind bending puzzles and defeat bosses.

apps.name: Bribe The Brave
apps.short_description: Rule a fantasy realm where heroes don't take orders - they take bribes. Build your settlement, place gold bounties on deadly monsters, and entice autonomous warriors, rogues, and mages to fight for your cause. Expand, defend, and let coin do the commanding in this indirect-control RTS.

apps.name: Brighter than Burning
apps.short_description: A fast-paced running-focused platformer inspired by classic side-scrollers.

apps.name: Broken & Loved
apps.short_description: Broken & Loved is an interactive visual novel which tells the story of  Evangeline and Rei, two university students entangling their lives in a love story fill with reflection, drama, sweetness and happiness.

apps.name: Broken Build Simulator
apps.short_description: Love roguelites? Well so do I! So I made a game that combines them all, with modes like 20 Minutes Till Lunch and Vampire Revivers. Blast away at ridiculous monsters in this highly detailed and accurate simulation of what playing a video game is like.

apps.name: Bubble Hunters
apps.short_description: Pop bubbles, dodge danger and master 100 handcrafted levels in this colorful 2D arcade platformer. Play solo or team up with a friend in online co-op, then chase high scores in Survival and Marathon modes.

apps.name: Buffet Simulator
apps.short_description:
Build your buffet empire! Grow your restaurant from the ground up and expand to become the biggest buffet by yourself or in co-op with up to 4 players. 

Handle the cooking, cleaning, customers, and staffing as you create the most expansive menu possible!

apps.name: Bug Fix Billionaire
apps.short_description: Build the most successful video game store in town! Develop your own games, stock your shelves with the latest hits, and grow your small shop into the ultimate gaming empire with employees, an esports team, loot boxes, and much more.

apps.name: Bullet Factory
apps.short_description: A factory that makes bullets, turrets that fire them, and a horde of living scrap that wants your metal. Design your ammo module by module, from junkyard tinkering to the far future, coached over the radio by Granny Odette.

apps.name: BumpBall
apps.short_description: BumpBall is a turn-based multiplayer football game where you plan your moves, predict your opponents and launch your entire team at once. Master unique squads and abilities in fast, chaotic 4v4 matches.

apps.name: Burger Shooter
apps.short_description: Your burger was stolen. Now everyone pays. Dash through fast-paced retro-inspired levels, chain kills to survive, unlock new weapons and upgrades, battle dangerous mafia enemies, and fight your way to the final boss in this adrenaline-fueled FPS.

apps.name: BURN THE WITCH
apps.short_description:
THEY TOLD ME TO MAKE THE BURN THE WITCH.  ROGUELIKE IN THE DARK FANTASY SETTING.
I'M NOT AGAINST IT

apps.name: Can 'Em All
apps.short_description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

apps.name: Candy Factory
apps.short_description: Build a candy factory on a cake island floating in the clouds. Mould candies, flavour them, top them and send them by road to the Candy Carousel. Chain 59 works into ever sweeter recipes, spin the reward machine, weather gumball storms and sugar quakes, and finish the carousel in five ages.

apps.name: Canvas Attack!
apps.short_description: Step into the bohemian world of early 20th-century France in Canvas Attack! This roguelike deckbuilder transforms the act of painting into a tactical puzzle battle. Fill empty canvas cells before despair overwhelms you, and juggle your finances and sanity to survive.

apps.name: Capital Criminal
apps.short_description: Start in debt. Build an underworld empire in this retro economic strategy game. Buy low, trade across 12 cities and weigh police, gang and debt risks. Reinvest in longer campaigns and grow your fortune before the deadline: 30, 90 or 365 days.

apps.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
apps.short_description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

apps.name: Card Survival: The Slacker’s Life
apps.short_description: "Card Survival: The Slacker’s Life" is a card-stacking + urban survival simulation game.

apps.name: CardCraft Champions
apps.short_description: A unique roguelike deckbuilding auto battler with many strategic choices. Customize your cards and discover powerful combinations.

apps.name: Carry the Pack Rack
apps.short_description: One car, two drivers! Team up where one controls the steering wheel and the other handles the gas. Overcome obstacles through perfect coordination. Enjoy the chaos with local or online co-op. Can you reach the finish line without crashing?

apps.name: Cartomancy
apps.short_description:
Turn-based RPG style experience with emphasis on RNG and hints of team building strategy. Uncover a metaphysical mystery from an unlikely inheritance. Cipher the code and face the powers that may be.

This isn't just a game, It's an initiation.

apps.name: CARVEGRAM
apps.short_description: Carvegram is a satisfying puzzle game where you carve cute miniature figurines out of blocks. Inspired by 3D nonograms: use the numbers on each line to work out what to break and what to paint in this meditative brain-buster with over 300 puzzles that's easy to learn but hard to put down.

apps.name: Castillon
apps.short_description: Castillon is an RTS + TD base-building strategy hybrid. Gather resources, explore and fortify your defenses during the day. Then survive waves of enemies attacks through the night. Level up, improve your stats, and master 4 schools of magic to become the ultimate wizard warrior.

apps.name: Cats Love Cakes
apps.short_description: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.

apps.name: Celestial Routes
apps.short_description: A third-person space survival game where seamless planet landings meet debt, fuel costs, fines, taxes, base ownership, and rebellion.

apps.name: Ceto-7
apps.short_description: Ceto-7 is a single-player underwater survival horror. Play as a salvage diver navigating a flooded alien mining facility, hunted by an apex predator, and hired to destroy sensitive corporate data. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to ignore what you've been hired to bury.

apps.name: Chad Billionaire
apps.short_description: Start broke. Work terrible jobs. Put that cash to work in real estate, businesses, stocks, acquisitions, and crypto until working for money becomes somebody else's problem. The numbers are exaggerated. The financial logic underneath them isn't.

apps.name: Chaos Protocol
apps.short_description: Chaos Protocol is a horror TPS game currently being developed by a solo developer. Players must destroy enemies and corrupted Cores to cleanse the area.

apps.name: Charming Blood: Twelve days
apps.short_description: Embrace darkness as an unwitting vampire in this choice-driven romance. Navigate ancient powers, brewing conflicts, and passionate relationships with four captivating vampires who could become your greatest allies – or something more. When night falls, will you surrender to its dangers?

apps.name: Chess Fantasy
apps.short_description: Chess Fantasy is a 3D chess game where you customize the world around you. Play classic chess or evolve the rules into your own game modes, online or with friends. Battle rivals and complete challenges to unlock new pieces, and build a place that truly feels like home.

apps.name: Chess of the Hidden Gates
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a Chinese chess move: the horse leaps, the cannon fires over a screen, the pawn crosses the river and never turns back. Every enemy strike marks its target square first. Step aside and it misses. Breach the Eight Gates. Play, or be taken.

apps.name: Chess Pit
apps.short_description: Two teams. One giant chessboard. Every kill earns your team a move, then you climb inside a hundred-foot chess piece and drive it across the arena, crushing anyone where it lands. Real-time chess with no turns, no waiting, and a whole lot of gunfire. Take the enemy king to win.

apps.name: Cinderpeak
apps.short_description: Carry the last flame up a mountain that has gone dark. Cinderpeak is a hard, precise 2D platformer: jump, climb and dash through ten chapters, each with its own rule, with a flame on your head that is starting to remember who put it out.

apps.name: CityGenesis
apps.short_description: CityGenesis is an authentic city-building simulation where you nurture a living economy. As the ruler of a small city-state, develop your city’s industries and lead your citizens to prosperity.

apps.name: Claw and Conjure
apps.short_description: Claw and Conjure is an async PvP auto-battler with fantasy RPG flair. Upgrade your town to synergize with your build, then race into battle against real players. Hire assassins, deploy traps, and resurrect exploding minions as you climb the global leaderboards.

apps.name: Clayborn Idle
apps.short_description: Forge legendary gear, shape its stats, and chase the ideal build in Clayborn Idle – an incremental ARPG where semi-turn-based combat collides with a deep progression system. Build game-breaking combinations, grow your utility skills, and master a world shaped by both battle and craftsmanship.

apps.name: Click Flip
apps.short_description: Click Flip is a short incremental game about clicking tiles, earning points, buying upgrades, and causing crazy tile combos.

apps.name: Clone Clicker
apps.short_description: Build the clone empire of your dreams. Assign clones to do jobs, increasing your productivity and amassing even more riches with which you may create more clones. Reach for the stars and take the universe (and more) into your clutches.

apps.name: CluckFront
apps.short_description: CluckFront is a top-down PvP looter-shooter featuring mutant chickens as the main characters. Choose your combat elevation: hold your ground on a specific tier or storm the heights. Select from a variety of Makeshift weapons, and various maps, and three game modes—either on online or via LAN

apps.name: Coastal Cargo
apps.short_description: Coastal Cargo is a strategy simulation game about becoming the world's best Naval Logistician. Chart trade routes between ports in a sprawling archipelago. Drop boats, start transporting cargo, and earn your rewards. How long can your empire last in this ever more challenging environment?

apps.name: Cocaine Smuggler
apps.short_description: Smuggle illegal cargo across dangerous waters, evade the Coast Guard and DEA, upgrade your planes and boats, and make it home with the cash.

apps.name: Cold Response
apps.short_description: Explore and survive a war torn Sweden through the eyes of an unknown soldier, alone or with friends.

apps.name: Computer Sillow: Jobcersize
apps.short_description: The Computerian-Workplace-Initative! Need a Job? Need some Excersize? You need some Jobcersize!

apps.name: Concrete Coffin
apps.short_description: The surface is gone. 11,581 survivors are crammed into an unfinished 10,000-capacity bunker. Balance 6 core resources, make critical choices on advisor reports, manage your workforce, and keep the shelter from collapsing.

apps.name: CONDEMNED: Nightfall
apps.short_description: Survival horror set in a dark 1950's NYC. In this social deduction tactical RPG, a curse has fractured a gathering of guests. Will you fight to survive the night as an *Innocent*, or embrace the shadows and hunt your peers as *The Cursed*? Uncover the truth to survive.

apps.name: Console Repair Simulator
apps.short_description: Inherit your uncle's dusty console shop on a Tokyo back street. Sell new hardware, haggle for used consoles, then open them up on the repair mat: unscrew every screw, find the fault, swap the part, power on. Restore, grade, resell, and turn the top floor into a 90s Game Saloon.

apps.name: Cosmic Clicker
apps.short_description: Build a cosmic energy empire in this colorful incremental sci-fi game. Click, automate production, unlock technologies, explore distant planets, collect artifacts, raise cosmic pets, and ascend to unlock permanent upgrades.

apps.name: Council & Conflict
apps.short_description: Assume the role of a national leader in an original world of competing powers, and steer your country through diplomacy, trade, internal politics, and war as crises test your ability to hold the state together and shape the world order. How will you lead?

apps.name: Coup de Grass
apps.short_description: Start with a single sickle and a small field. Cut and sell grass, automate your workforce, optimize supply chains, and build a sprawling incremental empire.

apps.name: Cover Up!
apps.short_description: Hide in plain sight. Cover Up! is an online 30-players hide-and-seek where you are the camouflage: paint your body to melt into the world, hold your nerve as seekers stalk past, and win by being invisible in full view.

apps.name: Cowgirl Milk Cafe
apps.short_description: You came to town to sell berries, but ended up managing a café with charming cow girls! Mix delicious cocktails, save the café from going under, and grow closer to your staff — and their attractive boss. Who knew a new job could change your life so much?

apps.name: Cozy Crest
apps.short_description: Awaken ancient elemental powers, shape your home, and help villagers bring their island back to life. Settle into this cozy open-world life sim, solo or with up to three friends.

apps.name: Creature Lab 2
apps.short_description: Conquer the world in the name of science! Study DNA, create mutagens, and grow mutated limbs to design your own monsters. Send them on missions across the globe, spread panic, collect bodies, samples, and chemicals, then use them in your next experiments.

apps.name: Creepy Meal
apps.short_description:
Creepy Meal is a co-op exploration, survival, and cooking game where absolutely nothing is safe.
Players must explore mysterious locations, collect  ingredients, drag them back, and cook them into high-value dishes and try not to become part of the menu.

apps.name: CRIMVEIL
apps.short_description: CRIMVEIL is a 2D dark fantasy action-survival game. Fight monsters, unleash and upgrade skills, craft weapons, armor, and potions to protect the ancient ring from the black-armored invaders trying to destroy the barrier.

apps.name: Cropocalypse
apps.short_description: Plant. Grow. Harvest. Outplay. A farming party game for one to four farmers on one field. Spread your roots to wall off rivals, haul your harvest home, raid their stores and guard yours from foxes and bears. When the market bell rings, the farmer who sells the most wins.

apps.name: Crownslayers
apps.short_description: Crownslayers is a roguelite turn-based roleplaying game, where you get to control two teams of heroes across separate timelines. Battle your way through a series of universes, bending time and space to affect multiple timelines, and future playthroughs!

apps.name: Crumbeats
apps.short_description: Revive a silent speaker and rebuild the beat in this music-driven incremental arcade game. Shatter Crumbs, collect Echoes, unlock instruments, and stack upgrades into an evolving groove.

apps.name: Crystal Ascend
apps.short_description: A simple incremental game where you nurture crystal elementals by destroying floating crystals and harvesting aether. Upgrade the skill tree, unlock new abilities to gather resources faster, and build your ultimate crystal companions.

apps.name: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
apps.short_description: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

apps.name: Cult of the Red Heifer
apps.short_description: Horror RPG FPS set in a dystopian United States controlled by a fanatical cult determined to create the perfect Red Heifer. Play as the Firestarter, a normal person who has decided to resist the Cult against all odds

apps.name: Curvelicious 2
apps.short_description: The classic curve game, rebuilt in 3D as a party game for 2 to 4 on one screen or up to 8 online. Your Curve never stops and leaves a solid trail. Box your friends in, blast gaps through their trails and be the last one alive.

apps.name: Cyber Siege
apps.short_description: Take control of a combat mech in an old-school sci-fi shooter. Upgrade your machine and unlock powerful support drones. Face alien creatures and hostile machines alone or with up to 3 friends in local co-op.

apps.name: Daluob
apps.short_description: Go solo or co-op to create unique builds. Nothing goes to waste: every successful build is preserved as a permanent "Bloodline." These Bloodlines scavenge gear while you're away and can be inherited by your next character to fast-track your setup and push power limits.

apps.name: Dandy Len's Toystore
apps.short_description: TOYSTORE is a survival horror game in which you must explore an underground shopping mall that was suddenly shut down for unknown reasons. The events take place in the early 90s, and you have been tasked with repairing the elevator that leads to the exit, in order to finalize the closure procedures.

apps.name: Dark Eyes - Super Soldier 2
apps.short_description: Continue the fight in the Dark Eyes universe as the Super Soldier battles the Delma and the elite Alpha commander. Experience fast-paced combat, massive battles, stealth, upgrades, and powerful abilities in this chaotic sci-fi action shooter.

apps.name: Day 31
apps.short_description: You were bitten hours ago. The clock in your blood is already running — and it isn't a virus. Fight through the waves of the dead, trade your nerve to a demon who was here before the city, and hold onto yourself for one more wave. Turn, and it's over.

apps.name: Dead On Arrival
apps.short_description: Step into the shoes of a CSI in Dead On Arrival, the ultimate crime scene investigation game. Analyse scenes, collect evidence, and use real-life forensic tools to solve cases. Test your problem-solving skills and uncover the truth to catch the killer. Do you have what it takes to crack the case?

apps.name: Dead Ringer
apps.short_description: It begins with a phone plugged into a faulty socket and an electric malfunction, it ends with seven dead and one missing... Detective Maxwell Morgan must navigate the testimonies of both the living and the dead to find a murderer before it's too late.

apps.name: DeadShare
apps.short_description: Six seats. Six players. One game show that smiles while it watches you. Make your secret pick, read the room, and stay in your seat while the wheel turns on SIXFOLD, the 2010 TV show nobody was meant to see.

apps.name: Deadshift
apps.short_description: Spend your last cash on a gun, a perk or a way out. DEADSHIFT is a single-player, top-down zombie survival roguelike. Repair barricades, unlock rooms and evolve your weapons across six maps. Beat the wave-30 boss, then keep fighting in endless mode.

apps.name: Death at Fleming Manor
apps.short_description:
"Your job is to write the death certificate."
Investigate a mysterious death in a British manor in 1959. Explore eerie scenes, analyze evidence, and complete death certificates and emergency reports. A forensic mystery with art inspired by 1960s European detective comics.

apps.name: Deblock
apps.short_description: A short, satisfying incremental game about breaking blocks. Dig deeper, unlock new tools and upgrades, and break even more blocks.

apps.name: Deck Breaker - A Roguelike Deckbuilder
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a focus on deep strategy, synergy and crazy combos. Build your deck as you adventure with over 200 cards and 35 heroes that each warp the rules — designed by a former Hearthstone set-design lead. Free demo out now!

apps.name: Decks of Valor: Fantasy Card Battles
apps.short_description: Choose from more than 70 ready-made decks and battle fantasy heroes in tactical card duels. Play offline against deck-aware AI, learn in a short interactive tutorial, or enter a 32-deck knockout tournament.

apps.name: Deep Breath
apps.short_description: Deep Breath is a third-person PvPvE extraction shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Team up or play solo, scavenge, fight, and escape in 25-minute missions filled with AI threats, tactical decisions, and fast-paced action.

apps.name: Deep Dive Dungeon
apps.short_description: A sword-and-sorcery dungeon built from location cards. Scavenge rare loot, build your deck on the fly to define your playstyle, and break out before it's too late. Play solo or team up with friends!

apps.name: Defend the Sacred Well
apps.short_description: Defend the Sacred Well in a single-player action defense game. Choose from three heroes and three maps, combine skills and alliance bonuses, dodge boss attacks, and protect the well through twenty waves. Then take your build into Endless Mode.

apps.name: DEFY
apps.short_description: Two nations, each certain it is the hero, fight over a beautiful world running out of supply. Blow the bridges, burn the forests, bring the buildings down. Villagers hide in cellars or take up arms, and a downed aircraft falls on what lies beneath it. Real-time strategy for up to eight leaders.

apps.name: Dejinochi
apps.short_description: Dejinochi is a tiny virtual pet that lives right on your desktop. Feed it, care for it, watch it grow into different creatures, and eventually say goodbye as it heads out into the world. Old friends might even come back to visit.

apps.name: Delivery Time
apps.short_description:
Jump! Grind rails! Boost through the city and deliver packages as quickly as you can while also scoring some style points!
Get ready for frantic time trials, loaded with parcels to deliver to happy customers.

apps.name: Delve Survivors
apps.short_description:
A blend of classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawling with the intensity of modern survivors games. 
Set the pace with every step as you unlock multiple dungeons and blast through swarms of enemies! 
Gather loot, customize your build, and learn to survive.. the Delve!

apps.name: Demockracy
apps.short_description: Build a political party in a fictional country and play for one thing: win power and keep it. Recruit politicians, conquer regions, win elections. There are clean paths and dirty games. Everyone has a price. What's yours?

apps.name: Demon of the time
apps.short_description: Fight cultists armed with futuristic weapons in a world where ancient Japan collides with broken time. Battle hordes of enemies, collect sacred artifacts, and stop the Demon of Time before reality itself collapses.

apps.name: DEPOT
apps.short_description: DEPOT is a 1-6 player co-op horror game about working the worst warehouse shift imaginable. Find the items on your list, load your cart, pack the orders and ship them out, while trying not to attract the things roaming between the shelves.

apps.name: Desire and Consequence
apps.short_description: A mysterious romantasy adventure visual novel where your choices take you on different paths with over six romanceable characters. You must find the truth about your past, discover the secrets of each character, and navigate the lure of power, romance, and their consequences.

apps.name: Desktop Bonsai Towns
apps.short_description: First world: Cyberpunk Town. A tiny voxel bonsai grows on your desktop for hours while a cyberpunk city builds itself along its trunk and branches. Watch residents live their lives as storms, meteors and giant invaders strike. Unlock pruning shears and collect a variety of bonsai styles.

apps.name: Desktop Bug Killer
apps.short_description:
This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves.
Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.

apps.name: Desktop Cozy Cat Tree
apps.short_description: Build a cat tree right on your desktop. Cats climb the post, leap from the top and bounce off the rides you place, earning gold with every hit. Arrange rides, meet a growing crew of cats and decorate your Cat House in a cozy idle game that plays quietly beside your work.

apps.name: Desktop Pet Engine
apps.short_description: Place your favorite characters on your desktop!A desktop idle game for work, study, and fun. Summon cute companions to keep you company, vent stress, or collect characters. Quickly access productivity tools like notepads, Pomodoro timers, and task lists—making your desktop lively and efficient!

apps.name: DeskTrack
apps.short_description: A cozy desktop companion with toy cars and a focus timer. Let a little car cruise while you work or study, earn miles to collect cars and scenery, then build your own tracks or take the wheel for a break.

apps.name: Despiry
apps.short_description: Despiry is a top-down sci-fi roguelite for 1 to 4 players with ARPG-style loot and run-based builds. Explore a hostile alien world, fight swarms, stack relics and passives, and bring back materials for permanent upgrades. There's no end to reach, only how far you go before enemies outgrow you.

apps.name: Dicebloom
apps.short_description: Roll the die and wake a twilight garden. Every hit sets off a chain of blooming: plants grow their neighbours, bees fly, seeds sprout and multipliers climb. Build a garden engine that pays a rising debt every week in this cozy dice roguelite.

apps.name: Digging In The Desert
apps.short_description: You lost your hat in the middle of a vast desert and must keep digging to find it!

apps.name: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar
apps.short_description: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

apps.name: Direlands: Extraction
apps.short_description: Direlands: Extraction blends looter shooter progression, extraction gameplay, and classic fantasy RPG adventure. Explore dangerous realms through ancient portals, gather powerful loot, and fight your way home—or lose everything you carry.

apps.name: DispatchControl
apps.short_description: Run a fire and ambulance dispatch center on real-world maps. Answer emergency calls, assess incidents and send the right crews while keeping units in reserve. Play Dispatch Control solo or in online co-op with up to six players, in free play or 16 campaign chapters.

apps.name: District Null
apps.short_description: District Null is a cyberpunk city simulation. Traffic, energy, fire services, police, schools and entertainment all run at the same time.

apps.name: DOCTRINEERS
apps.short_description: DOCTRINEERS is a turn-based strategy game where no two games are ever alike. Strategize and plan with your unique doctrinal units and adapt to new battlefields in a single-player campaign and online multiplayer.

apps.name: Domino Party
apps.short_description: Stand up thousands of dominoes to build a picture, then watch it all topple in one glorious chain! Make domino art and up to 10,000-piece jigsaws from your own photos with friends, then party in the lodge and playland with 25 mini-games like curling and sled races.

apps.name: Don't Drink
apps.short_description:
A strange night. A questionable decision. And a can you probably shouldn't have opened.

Don't Drink offers a small but charismatic world with RPG elements and 'interesting' foes.

apps.name: Doomy Downer
apps.short_description: A cute block hero, dragged down through a grim voxel dungeon. Souls-like combat: read the glint, then parry, clash or roll. At every stair, a gate of flowers or a gate of thorns: mow down a horde in the open, or duel champions in the dark. Your loot is your build. Death is permanent.

apps.name: DoubleShake
apps.short_description: Grab, shake, throw, and kick to save your islands from total chaos in this action-packed blast-to-the-past 2.5D Platformer inspired by some of our favorite 5th generation games!

apps.name: Doug's Playground
apps.short_description: Catch fish, ace the minigames to grade your haul, and turn it into playground parts. Stack them on the ship, send them off, and do it again. Draft charms, hire a crew, and when you sink, spend your prestige tokens and sail once more.

apps.name: Dr. Tod's Very Good Clinic
apps.short_description: A chaotic physics-based medical party game for 1–6 players. Carry patients, perform surgery, and try to save lives with your friends as everything goes horribly wrong. No medical license required. Safety first. Probably.

apps.name: DragHunter
apps.short_description: Link swords, cut down skulls, and build your way out of danger. DragHunter is a turn-based dungeon puzzle RPG where every chain feeds your next upgrade—and every turn gives the dungeon another chance.

apps.name: Dragon Khan
apps.short_description: Dragon Khan is a third-person action RPG set in Ithannar, a world ruled by dragons, where the player controls Botu, a unique green draconate born with wings and elemental power, drawn into a conflict triggered by the disappearance of a dragon Khan and the invasion of the forest domain.

apps.name: Drawquarium
apps.short_description: Draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.

apps.name: Dreadmiles
apps.short_description: Combine weapon modules, destroy obstacles and spread fire in this claymation rogue-lite horde survivor. Choose your route, take on missions and giant bosses, and head back to your truck before the Seep closes in.

apps.name: DRENCHED
apps.short_description: Drenched is a 3D exploration adventure where a burnt-out artist becomes a fish. Switch between the two characters, and traverse two mirrored worlds to uncover her story. Splash puddles on the surface and blow bubbles underwater to explore, solve puzzles, and reconnect her past and present.

apps.name: Driver Wars
apps.short_description: A chaotic and satirical late-stage capitalistic driving simulator. In this low-poly 3D world, live out the fantasies and nightmares of countless commuters gridlocked in traffic as you ram, blow up, set ablaze, toss donuts at, honk, grapple, and total hordes of terrible and aggressive NPC drivers.

apps.name: Dubbed
apps.short_description: Pick a scene. Hand out the parts. Perform it together over your own microphones and get the clip back with your voices on it. Every line records separately, so you can retake the one that didn't land — then watch the finished dub with the whole room.

apps.name: Dungeon Miner
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op mining game: go down the mine, dig up ore, and carry it back to the ship. Small gear stays on your body, but giant crystals must be carried in your own two arms. Pull the Dungeon Core and the mine starts to collapse. You have three minutes to get the cart back to the ship.

apps.name: Dungeon Wanderers
apps.short_description: A 3D action RPG in a dungeon that changes each time you dive in. Read enemy attacks and answer with guards, parries, and dodges. Your playstyle shapes which skills awaken in you. Capture monsters and raise them as companions to fight by your side. Play solo or in up to 4-player online co-op.

apps.name: Duoshift
apps.short_description: Defend The Wall on a tactical 11x7 grid using your pair of battle vehicles. Outmaneuver waves of scavenged war machines, unleash game-breaking hacks and chain synergies. Draft, fight, and survive in this endlessly replayable tactical roguelite.

apps.name: Dust & Diesel: Deadland Delivery
apps.short_description: Survive in a desolate post-apocalyptic world as a trucker, building your delivery empire. Customize and upgrade your trucks, fight off bandits, and navigate dangerous terrains. Complete challenging missions and uncover the wasteland secrets. Are you ready to conquer the Deadlands?

apps.name: DUSTBLOOM
apps.short_description: Team up with friends in this 1-4 player co-op survival game. Build and defend your base, automate your production, haul ore with your truck, and terraform a dead red desert into a lush green world. Craft weapons to survive nightly skeleton attacks and uncover the dark mystery of the lost 14th team.

apps.name: Echoes of Stella
apps.short_description: Echoes of Stella is a first-person horror adventure built around a unique echolocation device. Use it to navigate a distorted mirror world, revealing your surroundings in brief moments of clarity. Time your scans carefully, or risk exposing yourself.

apps.name: Eldritch 2
apps.short_description: Minor Key Games' classic horror romp returns in this bigger and better sequel. Eldritch 2 is a first-person stealth action game inspired by immersive sims, roguelikes, and the works of H. P. Lovecraft.

apps.name: Elecade
apps.short_description:
Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning.
Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

apps.name: Elements: Soul of Fire
apps.short_description: The light of the world fades. Evil hearts seek the Power of the Elements - the forces which bind the universe together - thus threatening all of existence. An homage to the 8-BIT era with a charming art style.

apps.name: Elf Shift
apps.short_description: Only 4 real time days left until Christmas. Flawlessly pack 10,000 toys, unlock new products, and improve your skills to speed up the production line. Deliver the boxes on time, don't get too curious about the weird things happening around you, and most importantly... do not anger Santa.

apps.name: Elsewhere Owl Post
apps.short_description: A cozy resource management game where you sort magical packages and assign them to the perfect owl for successful delivery. Care for your hardworking owls, grow your clientele, and uncover their stories along the way. Discover distant lands as your owls travel far and wide to complete each delivery.

apps.name: Enchanted Oceans Inc
apps.short_description: Take to the seas and help bring life back to a shattered ocean archipelago in this third person ocean adventure created by a marine biologist! Make use of your trusty vessel, deep sea diving skills, and a sprinkling of magic to achieve your goals and help the people of Rhu.

apps.name: End My Dry Spell
apps.short_description: Lorfeld is a small wine town on the Rhine gorge—and this summer, the river has dropped to a level nobody living has seen. Choose who you stand beside, what you’re willing to pay when you’re wrong, and who stays when the harbour finally starts moving again.

apps.name: Endless Reach
apps.short_description: Fly a smuggler's run into a swarm of thousands. Every orb you catch is XP and cargo. Stay and the heat brings turrets, then a boss. Call the jump, hold the zone while the drive charges, and bank it all. Die, and you keep a fraction. The music follows how well you fly.

apps.name: ErosNet: Glitch in Love
apps.short_description: ErosNet: Glitch in Love is an erotic visual novel and dating sim with an ironic cyberpunk storyline! Explore biomes, reveal avatars' fetishes, and unlock spicy scenes. Upgrade your PC to transform pixels into juicy 2D art!

apps.name: ESCAPE FROM TOUHOU
apps.short_description: A single-player top-down extraction shooter where you command Reimu, Marisa, and Nitori-crash-landed in a war-torn desert-by switching between them in real time. Secure supplies to survive, and with the allied forces' help, restore the dimensional transporter and return to Gensokyo.

apps.name: Estranged: Act I
apps.short_description: Estranged tells the story of a lone fisherman, whose ship is stranded on a mysterious island during a violent storm. Explore the rich environments and meet the curious inhabitants of the island as you find a way back to the mainland.

apps.name: European Airfreight Tycoon
apps.short_description: European Air Freight Tycoon is an aviation management simulation. Build your cargo airline, coordinate flights across 26 major European airports, manage 18 aircraft, gather resources, construct assembly hangars, trade stocks, and lead your company to the top of Europe.

apps.name: Everdeep Idle
apps.short_description: An ARPG-inspired Idle game where the fighting happens automatically, but the build is yours. Choose up to six classes, reshape skills with augments and build-changing loot, and set up triggers and loadouts that react for you. Let it run while you’re busy, or dig into the numbers to min-max.

apps.name: Evilos
apps.short_description: Evilos is an action tower defense game where you play as an ancient evil sorcerer battling endless waves of do-gooders. Tear down the kingdom with a vast arsenal of evolvable magic weapons and spells, and bolster your defenses with elite minions across 10 acts. This time, you are the final boss!

apps.name: EVO RNG
apps.short_description: EVO RNG is slot-machine god-game - draft creatures, press spin and watch your ecosystem hunt, merge and evolve on its own. Collect, chase paylines, food chains and mythic creatures. Game does not contain any real money gambling elements.

apps.name: Evolution Survival
apps.short_description: Evolution Survival is a survival game where the universe evolves around you. The plants and animals you saw at the beginning will be different at the end, They may not even be there, the star may have gone supernova or shrunk into a white dwarf. Use the time you have to ensure your survival.

apps.name: EvoX
apps.short_description:
One island. A hundred ways to die.
Hunt, build, craft and fight your way from stone tools to gunpowder.
The island doesn't keep score. It just keeps going.

apps.name: EXCISA
apps.short_description: Sit down at a séance table in an abandoned house. Choose a tarot card. Roll the dice. Risk everything to summon the Angel who never lies. Every reach across the table might bring you closer to the truth—or seat something else opposite you. Five chairs. The dead have heard you, too.

apps.name: Exhibition of the Heart
apps.short_description:
Alice is a lonely university student who never got over her first crush, the upright and studious Sylvia. Until one day, she discovers that Sylvia is actually a shameless exhibitionist! Can the timid Alice win her heart? 
Find out in this cute nsfw yuri visual novel!

apps.name: Exodrift
apps.short_description: Exodrift is a rhythm action roguelite where you are a space delivery driver on the run. Deliver packages, destroy enemies on the beat, and escape hazardous procedurally generated planets.

apps.name: Extinction Cycle
apps.short_description: In this wave survival game, you incarnate a soldier testing a new kind of desensitising technology. You will not get out of the simulation until you become the perfect killing machine, welcome to the Extinction Cycle.

apps.name: FailRooms
apps.short_description: Experience liminal horror like never before. Inspired by the Backrooms, FailRooms traps you in an endless world of absurd architecture, broken spaces, and things that should never have been built. Laugh while you can. Can you escape a place that was never designed to make sense?

apps.name: Fall of the Final Age
apps.short_description: Take command of the last Stronghold of humanity, fighting back against the advancing monsters. Decide where to prioritize the forces of your Heroes, as the number of turns before the invasion is limited. A turn-based tactical strategy with RPG and roguelike elements.

apps.name: Fallen Crowns
apps.short_description: Four Kings and a Wizard once sealed the Abyss. Then the Wizard betrayed them, and the Kings fell. Rise from nothing and claim their four crowns across a war-torn fortress, storm-wracked skies, a corrupted grove and endless shadow. Grow stronger every run, then face the Wizard King himself.

apps.name: False Myth 2
apps.short_description: The true sequel to False Myth— a true classic JRPG × beautiful-heroine adventure! Rouge, the agile assassin, sets off with his companions to uncover the truth behind the mysterious girl Sylphina, weaving the most heartrending and fiery “Tale of Hearts.”

apps.name: Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator
apps.short_description: Become a Master Blacksmith in this cozy fantasy simulator. Restore and upgrade your workshop, forge magical weapons and armor, craft jewelry, and enchant powerful gear. Meet magical creatures and mysterious figures as you enjoy a relaxing crafting experience, solo or with friends in co-op.

apps.name: Fantasy Camp Builder
apps.short_description: A cozy campsite building game where you create medieval-fantasy campsites with charming decorations, warm lighting, and a relaxing atmosphere.

apps.name: Faulty Loops
apps.short_description: A set-and-play logic puzzle game driven by music. Place your units on the grid, press play and watch the playhead sweep across the board, firing each unit on the beat. Clear every enemy in a single loop to repair the corrupted tapes, one instrument at a time.

apps.name: Feeding Gooble
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

apps.name: Femboy & Futa Maidmare
apps.short_description: A psychological horror visual novel set in a neon-lit motel. Work the night shift, build relationships with the unusual staff, make choices, and investigate increasingly strange events as the line between memory and reality begins to blur.

apps.name: Femboy Futa Monster Girls
apps.short_description: Femboy Futa Monster Girls is an adult fantasy visual novel driven by your choices. Build relationships with six distinct characters, uncover their secrets, and play minigames ranging from card duels to rhythm challenges as you explore branching routes and multiple endings.

apps.name: Fernwick
apps.short_description: Some stories aren't told. They're left behind in the things we keep. In this hand-drawn point-and-click adventure, explore Grandma Junie's keepsake book, inspect the memories she left behind, and piece together the story of Fernwick.

apps.name: Fertile Crescent
apps.short_description: A real-time grand strategy game set in the Bronze Age. Lead one of 29 ancient civilizations from a single settler to an empire. Found cities, work the land, research new technologies, advance your culture, and wage war. Will your civilization outlive the age that made it?

apps.name: FFFF : Fatal Five Finger Fillet
apps.short_description:
Bet your fingers. A physically immersive horror roguelite.
Place your real fingers on the keyboard. Stab the knife between them.
Use rings and stab items to rack up a high score.
Can you keep your cool as the spinning blade closes in?

apps.name: Final Armada
apps.short_description: Build ships block by block, command your fleet in real-time space battles, and choose your path through a roguelike campaign. Upgrade your ships, watch them break apart in combat, and uncover what happened to the galaxy around you.

apps.name: FIND ALL 10: Greece
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 10: Greece. You will explore an ancient Greek city, the colorful streets of a historic town and the unique scenery of a modern Greek city. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

apps.name: Find The Needle
apps.short_description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

apps.name: Finding Buddies
apps.short_description: Finding Buddies is a romance visual novel where your dialogue choices shape Daniel’s story and relationships. Explore different scenes, meet new characters, and experience a narrative with interactive gameplay moments.

apps.name: Firearms Factory
apps.short_description: Firearms Factory is a WWII strategy game focused on weapon manufacturing and logistics. Starting in 1939, you manage a German war factory, expanding control over key regions by supplying battlefronts. Balance production, logistics, and territorial defense on the path to nuclear weapon development.

apps.name: First Bag
apps.short_description:
You are an invisible robber who steals valuables from the map, while the others — the police — hunt you down to catch you.
But you're only invisible while standing still. Move, and you can be seen. Steal money and valuables, furnish your home and level up your skills.

apps.name: Fish Battle Champion
apps.short_description: Fishing roguelite autobattler where every catch could become your next champion. Catch strange fish, discover rare bonuses, collect items, upgrade your team of fishes and fight through increasingly challenging battles.

apps.name: Fishing Town
apps.short_description: This is a desktop idle fishing game. Collect rare fish, upgrade your gear, and build your own pond and aquarium.

apps.name: Fix it 18+
apps.short_description: Repair electronics in a city of superheroes, villains and everyday breakdowns. Take devices apart, replace parts, solder and run your workshop. Meet recurring clients, chat with Riley and Scarlett, and get to know them beyond the counter. An electronics repair sim with adult romance.

apps.name: Flaming Fried Nutrition: Daydream
apps.short_description: A slow, strange pet-raising game with idle and horror elements, about a girl who loves hamburgers very, very much. Pet her beloved hamburger, feed it, dance for it, ride it. Adopt more hamburgers.

apps.name: Flat Earth Runner
apps.short_description: Endless runner. Sentient Yowie. Antarctic ice wall. The New World Order really does not want you finishing the lap. A PS1-style comedy about the dumbest possible way to prove the earth is flat.

apps.name: Fluffy Alchemist
apps.short_description: A cozy exploration game about a red panda alchemist. Explore five islands where night never falls, gather ingredients that each behave differently, brew potions and fill your Book of Brews. No timers, no enemies, nothing is ever lost when you fail.

apps.name: Folk-Tography
apps.short_description: Folk-Tography is a 4-player co-op cryptid photography extraction game. Photograph legendary creatures, investigate paranormal anomalies, manage scarce resources, and survive various dangers to escape with the evidence before the valley consumes you.

apps.name: Forest Mind
apps.short_description: Escape the noise of the city and seek refuge in your grandfather's forgotten cabin. But as night falls, the forest begins to reveal something far more terrifying than you expected.

apps.name: Forestless
apps.short_description: Forestless is an atmospheric psychological adventure that takes you on a journey through the world of fear, armed only with the magical arrow of hope. Explore the vastness of human nightmares, from the foggy lands of loneliness to the mountains of failure.

apps.name: Forge of the Fae
apps.short_description: Forge of the Fae is a story-rich pixel RPG inspired by Celtic folklore. Journey through a mysterious world, master the ARC Crystal System to unleash powerful magic, and face dangerous Fae in fast-paced, turn-based battles where your choices shape destiny.

apps.name: Forsaken Fleet
apps.short_description: A first-person pirate horror where a haunted fisherman is drawn into the legend of the Forsaken Fleet. Follow a mysterious compass. Sail through the fog. Explore forgotten places and survive the horrors that should have stayed buried at sea.

apps.name: Fractured Rift: Incremental
apps.short_description: An incremental RPG auto-battler where you build and customize a team of allies to conquer increasingly difficult floors.

apps.name: Fred's Idle Garden
apps.short_description: A cozy idle farming simulator that hangs out on your desktop while you work, study or just chill 🌻

apps.name: Frex: Ambivalence
apps.short_description: A high-speed action game blending fluid movement and stylish sword combat, as you push through intense stages and confront enemies shaped by a broken world.

apps.name: Frontier Tavern
apps.short_description: Run your own tavern in this first-person business simulator. Serve drinks, restock supplies and keep customers happy. Hire staff to automate daily tasks, unlock new drinks and reinvest your earnings to grow your business in the Old West.

apps.name: Full Metal Hell
apps.short_description: Full Metal Hell is a roguelite shooter combining physics-based collisions and active abilities. Choose from a wide variety of vehicles, weapons, and builds, and crush everything in your path through the mechanical hordes!

apps.name: Furry Snow Leopard
apps.short_description: Furry Snow Leopard is a seductive adult puzzle game featuring a charming snow leopard heroine. Uncover her boldest looks, unlock steamy illustrations, and step by step discover what lies behind her cold yet alluring gaze.

apps.name: FUTA gone WILD
apps.short_description: FUTA gone WILD - is a relaxing Arkanoid-style game where you destroy tiles to unlock hot animations with beautiful futanari.

apps.name: Futaland Love of the Dead
apps.short_description: Flirt with femboy and futanari characters in an 18+ NSFW visual novel mixing romance and zombie comedy. Build relationships through dialogue choices, unlock animated adult scenes, and tackle mini-games where you prepare pizza orders, mix cocktails, solve puzzles, and test your timing.

apps.name: Galactiball
apps.short_description:
The next great party game... until someone starts taking it seriously.
Kick your friends into the goal. Dive across the arena for a last-second save. Launch an opponent into an incoming boulder. Play locally with your friends or hit the ladder and show the world what you're made of!

apps.name: GALLANT
apps.short_description: GALLANT is a multiplayer platform shooter for 2-10 players. Throw vials, draw cards between rounds, and adapt your strategy as your powers evolve. When skill meets luck across the many arenas, only one can claim the title of Grand Alchemist of Fortune!

apps.name: Gardenkin
apps.short_description: Return life to a forgotten community garden. Clear the overgrowth, bring back the water, grow crops and flowers, and welcome seven neighbours back one by one, with a rabbit and a hedgehog lending a paw. A gentle, cozy garden restoration game.

apps.name: GemCremental
apps.short_description:
Craft a variety of gems and become the greatest witch!
It's a cozy incremental crafting game.

apps.name: Gene Gone Wild
apps.short_description: Build your own beast from animal heads, limbs, and tails. GENE GONE WILD is a creature-building survivor roguelite: buy and merge body parts, combine traits and synergies, and grow your gene talent tree as your tiny creature evolves into a walking arsenal.

apps.name: Generic Fighter Maybe
apps.short_description: A classic arcade-style 2D Fighting Game, wrapped up in a goofy, full-of-energy, stylized presentation that mixes great animation and zany battle moves with simplistic doodles!

apps.name: Genome Warriors : Resistance to Invasion
apps.short_description: In this roguelike top-down shooter game, progress by defeating enemies in randomly generated levels. Upgrade your cell, gain advantages with temporary boosts, and try different strategies each time.

apps.name: Geo Bobs
apps.short_description: GeoBobs is a multiplayer geo location party game! Study a picture, explore a 3D map, and race your friends to find where it was taken. Lock in your guess, earn points based on accuracy, and prove you've got the best eye for detail.

apps.name: Geometry Rift: Apocalypse
apps.short_description: The ultimate arcade chaos unfolds in this explosive bullet hell roguelite. Survive thousands of geometric enemies on screen, combine weapons and powers to create absurdly overpowered builds, and blast your way through colossal bosses solo or with a friend.

apps.name: Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory
apps.short_description: Run a Christmas gift factory with unruly gnomes in this short management game! Wrap gifts yourself, set up production equipment, manage your gnomes, and assign tasks. Turn a chaotic workshop into a smoothly running factory before Christmas.

apps.name: Ghosts Don't Need Doors
apps.short_description: Even ghosts dream of freedom! Help a little ghost escape a haunted mansion, where everyday objects hide clues to secret passages. Observe, deduce, and slip through walls to reach the moonlight.

apps.name: Glaciered
apps.short_description: Soar the seas at the end of time. 65 million years in the future, the world has frozen over, and the oceans have been sealed under a thick layer of ice. Become a Tuai—a species that evolved from birds—and protect the Everwinter in this futuristic underwater action game.

apps.name: Global Conflagration
apps.short_description: Global Conflagration is a real-time strategy game inspired by the classics featuring modern controls and streamlined mechanics. Build lots of tanks, infantry, helicopters and aircraft to destroy the enemy base.

apps.name: Glowpits: Farmers Arena
apps.short_description: Explore the world of GlowPits, collect valuable resources, defeat rival explorers, unlock unique characters, and upgrade powerful abilities in a fast-paced arena adventure filled with creatures, challenges, and endless progression.

apps.name: GNAP GNAP
apps.short_description: GNAP GNAP is a horde roguelite shooter where you pop ominous balloons that keep multiplying. Unlock items, harpoons and grow stronger with each run. Equip your harpoon, max your stats and defeat all the entities keeping you against your will.

apps.name: Gnome Acres
apps.short_description: A cozy farming game where a village of gnomes does the work. Draw fields, pick what grows, and watch your gnomes plant, water, harvest and haul every crop through spring, summer, autumn and winter.

apps.name: GO DUB YOURSELF!
apps.short_description: Grab a mic and dub over your favourite clips with your friends. Turn any video into a clip pack, share it on the workshop, then battle it out on the couch or online for up to 12 players. Auto score or judge each other, the choice is yours!

apps.name: Golfcremental
apps.short_description:
BUILD! GOLF! EARN! BUY!
Turn $50 into your own golfing empire by building custom golf courses and then automating them to get hole in ones. Unlock unique golf course pieces and use them in unique ways to make more money.

apps.name: Grandpa's Garden
apps.short_description: Grow weed, roll joints and deliver to your customers in this top-down pixel crime game while the police patrol the streets. Hire dealers and gardeners, launder your money and turn a motel room into an empire. Play alone or with up to five friends.

apps.name: Gravefever
apps.short_description: Punch, gun down, and freeze endless waves of monsters in this survivors-style roguelike. Grow your build from skill branches and capstones, topple mega-bosses to reach new arenas, and bank gold for permanent training. Every run ends in death — the clock is your score. How long can you last?

apps.name: Graveyard Cabin
apps.short_description: An FMV anomaly horror game. You are a night guard at a desolate graveyard. Monitor the cameras, spot the unnatural, and survive.

apps.name: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand
apps.short_description: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 22 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

apps.name: Gravity Defied Reincarnation
apps.short_description: An unofficial remake of the 2004 keypad phone classic. Lean the rider to keep the bike balanced, ride over hills and drops and reach the finish on 30 tracks. Original mode rebuilds the classic physics, Modern mode rides smoother. Four bikes, pixel art and 31 original songs.

apps.name: Greedspire
apps.short_description: Build powerful gear combos in a push-your-luck roguelike auto-battler. Enchant your gear to +20 or watch it shatter. Move to the next floor, or risk your entire run for richer loot in deadlier rooms. 100 floors. One life. How greedy will you get?

apps.name: Greedy Little Kingdoms
apps.short_description: A short-run roguelike city builder. Gather timber, craft lanterns and magic potions, fulfil demands from frogs, plague doctors, and swamp dragons. Explore the hex map, survive the King's moods, and find the artefacts that break your economy wide open. Repeat.

apps.name: GRINDWORM
apps.short_description: A short horror game where you pilot a grinddozer through a nightmare buried underground. Why are the walls twitching? Is that flesh? Yes. It is. This is no longer mining. This is surgery... DON'T. STOP. DIGGING.

apps.name: Gross Survivors
apps.short_description: Play as the grossest survivors in town in this fast-paced top-down roguelite! Armed with raw fart power and other foul abilities, blast through endless enemy swarms across 2 arenas. Collect coins, upgrade your powers, and turn your nastiest traits into ultimate weapons!

apps.name: Guns 'n Goblins
apps.short_description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

apps.name: GymPup
apps.short_description: GymPup is a furry-themed romance narrative game that blends desktop idle gameplay with visual novel elements. Through their journey together, you watch the two protagonists grow and change—inside and out.

apps.name: Hacker Cats
apps.short_description: Who needs human hackers when you have cats? Lead a crew of fluffy cybercriminals, hack servers, steal valuable data, research new technologies, and conquer the Internet one paw at a time.

apps.name: Halmweit
apps.short_description: A cozy building game to play alone or with friends. You share one village, one storehouse and everyone who lives there. Chop trees, plant fields, lay a railway and get your village through the winter. There's no fighting, and you can't lose.

apps.name: Haul Yeah!
apps.short_description: Load it, strap it, drive it. A colourful delivery-driving sandbox for one or two players. Stack real physics cargo, tighten the straps and haul it across a mountain county in split-screen co-op or solo. Build your business with better trucks, custom parts and bigger jobs.

apps.name: Heartreave
apps.short_description: A turn-based hack-and-slash where every fight is played with cards. Assemble a party, solo or in online co-op, and craft unique builds by combining cards, passives, talents, relics, creature hearts and island hearts to find the best synergies and push ever deeper.

apps.name: Heat: Pedal to the Metal
